Package fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.control

Interface Controller

public interface Controller
The interface for the Controller The controller is launched at the beginning of the application Its role is to control the model and the view and to perform designated action on the model

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      void initialize() throws fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.PacManException
      Initialization of the controller at the beginning of the application. Depending on the developer choices, this could for example initialize a new game by default This would also create and launch the view and user interface
      Throws:
      fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.PacManException - if the initialization fails

      void initializeNewGame() throws fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.PacManException

      Throws:
      fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.PacManException - if the initialization fails
